suiteTitle: Language Selector Security, Firewall & Tamper-Resistance Suite

securityAssertions.description: resolveEffectiveResolverMode strictly enforces 'PRODUCTION' whenever VERCEL_ENV, APP_ENV, or NODE_ENV equals 'production', regardless of requested mode
resolveEffectiveLocale in PRODUCTION mode rejects fil-PH and ja-JP, falling back safely to platform default 'en-PH'
In QA mode, fil-PH is permitted for authorized testing, but ja-JP and en-US remain strictly rejected and fall back to 'en-PH'
Language selection interface and payloads have zero authority over countryCode, displayCurrency, chargeCurrency, payment provider, or settlement ledger
Language selector props and state have zero authority over user roles, permissions, session tokens, or account identity
Search input handles regex metacharacters (*, +, ?, (, ), [, ], {, }, ^, $, |, \) safely using plain case-insensitive string inclusion without regex execution
